rules.description: At least ten distinct destination ports have SYN attempts in this capture.
Observable RST (closed port) to distinguish it from filtering.
Payload containing a pattern (e.g. HTTP GET) for a signature rule.

manual_checks: Identify the scanning source and target and calculate the event count within the detector window fixed in E1. A whole-capture count does not establish a rate threshold.
R1 R2: Correlate source, target, timestamps and generated scan alert; repeated SYNs to one port are not ten ports.
R3: Assert the signature alert and show the matching request; bytes alone do not establish detection.
